decision: 378先实现同信息且真正进入腿chart的无学习反馈与解析范围/单位/符号验证，冻结候选和选择规则；随后新独立有界开发baseline测量，数值主门依据新旧最强经典绑定后才可学习。现在不准入PPO优化或正式5seed。
why_new_baseline: 376 prior52/52不是完整164开发suite，也无强经典对照。
现B1只输出aw轮差，ax/az零，单独不能检验腿几何更新。
新增Cart chart/滤波/权限改变后不可继承旧492经典的最强J资格；旧结果继续作能力底线，不复活失败D3分支。

next_implementation.method: B1 wheel feedback + opposite Cartesian force pair from public R0 radial feedback
next_implementation.public_inputs_only: Same delayed raw481 yaw/roll/gyro_x/joint encoders and causal route history; no current undelayed geometry/true plant parameters/contact/case identity at highlevel.
next_implementation.direction: e_L,e_R unit leg endpoint vectors from the same delayed public encoders; f=DeltaF*(e_L+e_R)/2 is least-squares projection of opposite radial requests onto (f,-f).
next_implementation.latent: (ax,az)=f/F0 with common shrink into the latent Box; aw uses original public B1. Keep same50Hz,slew,parking,Hsum,guard and chart-specific lowlevel geometry.
unit_and_sign_checks: Derive original radial-force/positive-d/left-right signs from fixed VMC/reference source;prove command sign and virtual work before code admission.
gamma<=1 input inBox;gamma2 symmetric first saturates atabs(d)>.0175m;asymmetric commonshrink recorded.
Reject direct renaming of old leg length actions as Fx/Fz.
next_implementation.rejected_unscaled_gain: Do not usec=.5/1 times3500N/m with .035m offset: peak61.25/122.5N vsF0=3.4335 makes pervasive saturation;gain normalized analytically before any outcome tuning.

selection_before_measurement: Keep oldB0,B1-route original parking,B1-withdraw and full CPU ability references. Newsamechart feedback is an additional strong comparison.
Freeze candidate list andwhole existing development cases,original monitor/success requirements andfixed gain selection before anynewbaseline.
Physical/design and full capability retention first;then controlled success/J,regular retention,then fixed candidate index for ties. No per-case controller picking or PPO-outcome tuning.

numerical_gate_before_learning.requirement: J<=min(.85*B,B-.05deg),whereB is the measured best eligible new/old same-information classic;retain every original classic success and full capability gates.
numerical_gate_before_learning.unreachable_exit: IfB<=.05deg or no physical/retention-qualified baseline or original task/metric cannot be matched,stop this scientific gate before learning;never lower threshold/change metric/subgroup to green.
